pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit complex, irregular geometry with stellate/jagged edges. Pixel gradients at boundaries are sharp but non-linear, creating a multi-pointed polygonal appearance across the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological network with distinct tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform, approximately 10-15% of the average patch width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth contour is visible along the dorsal ridge from the shoulder to the upper neck, corresponding to the mane's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A Red-billed Oxpecker (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) is perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
